prerequisites.credentials: synthetic/no production credentials; no CI permission or credential changes
prerequisites.versions: vetted immutable version/digest and provenance verification required; never floating latest
prerequisites.license: engine, rules, DB and redistribution terms reviewed separately
prerequisites.coverage: languages, targets, enabled scanners, exclusions with reasons/expiry, DB age limit and finding policy required

candidates.name: Trivy
candidates.exit_caution: default exit 0 may include findings; inspect policy output and configure gate explicitly

candidates.name: govulncheck
candidates.purpose: optional Go-specific known-vulnerability lens, only when relevant
candidates.exit_caution: structured output modes can succeed despite findings; retain mode-specific evidence and static-analysis limitations

required_gate_fixture_design.input: harmless synthetic source matching an owned/permitted detection rule or static synthetic advisory fixture; never execute malicious sample
required_gate_fixture_design.expect: known finding observed and policy gate rejects; missing detection is FAIL

required_gate_fixture_design.input: paired corrected synthetic input within declared coverage
required_gate_fixture_design.expect: scan completed, nonempty intended coverage, no policy violations, gate accepts

required_gate_fixture_design.input: controlled invalid config/unavailable required DB/read failure
required_gate_fixture_design.expect: ERROR/BLOCKED, never clean/PASS; distinguish from a policy finding

done_rule: declaration validity and exit 0 are not security PASS; missing required fixture/runtime evidence blocks DONE

implementation.activation: explicit only; shipped unresolved pins block before Docker
